# Soccer24

> > Live soccer scores, fixtures, and results from leagues worldwide with real-time updates and comprehensive match coverage.

Soccer24 is a sports platform operated by Livesport s.r.o. in Prague, providing live soccer match data, scores, and statistics to fans globally. The service emphasizes data protection and GDPR compliance in its journalism and content delivery.

## Key Topics

- Live soccer scores
- Match fixtures and results
- Real-time updates
- GDPR compliance
- Livesport s.r.o.
- Data protection
- Sports journalism
- Personal data privacy
- Soccer statistics
- League coverage
- Match coverage

## Privacy & Legal

- [GDPR and Journalism](https://www.soccer24.com/gdpr): GDPR compliance and data protection policy by Livesport s.r.o.
